description: Luchthavens Luchthavengebieden is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. Het luchthavengebied is het gebied dat bestemd is voor gebruik als luchthaven, met bijbehorende voorzieningen. De omvang van dit gebied bepaalt mede of een luchthavenbesluit nodig is, of dat met een luchthavenregeling kan worden volstaan. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are downloadable-data, luchtvaart, plangebieden, vliegvelden, wet-geluidhinder. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JPEG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-02-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
